text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

C05-001 · PWM command to configured ESCON DigIN1 set-value input · ESCON manual supports 10 Hz–5 kHz, 10–90% PWM and logic high >2.4 V typical. Verify set-value mode, frequency, scaling, polarity and failsafe against exact controller configuration.
C05-002 · PWM signal reference · The ESCON names J5.5 signal GND; Core-to-ESCON common is a proposed non-isolated reference. Verify grounds and noise before connection.
C05-003 · Separate run/stop request · Configure DigIN2 function and active polarity; deassertion is not a substitute for the physical E-stop.

C06-002 · 24 V return · Confirm polarity and current rating; source does not give installed supply contact labels.

C08-001 · Prime regulated logic supply · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C08-002 · Prime logic supply return · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C09-001 · X home signal · Trace actual switch pair, prove passive dry contact and NO/NC operation; verify input pull-up and firmware home direction.
C09-002 · X home return · Trace actual switch pair, prove passive dry contact and NO/NC operation; verify input pull-up and firmware home direction.

C10-001 · Heater branch fuse feed · Select fuse DC voltage/current/interrupt rating and conductor protection from actual heater/supply.
C10-002 · VFET power entry · Use XT30 J12, not small 2.54mm J11 auxiliary header; verify exact board, connector, PCB and load current limits.
C10-003 · Heater power return · Separate from logic supply/VMOT; verify return topology and protective earth as applicable.
C10-004 · Positive heater feed · J17.1 is downstream of factory Q25 high-side cutoff. Match heater voltage/current and output connector rating.
C10-005 · Thermally protected heater feed · Install rated cutoff mechanically/electrically according to its manufacturer and heater location.
C10-006 · Hotend A switched heater return · J17.2 is Q19 drain; configured output, tested startup-off and validated temperature feedback are mandatory before enabling heat.
C11-001 · Fan1 positive feed · Fan receives VFET rail, not a separately inferred 5V/12V supply. Match actual fan voltage/current.
C11-002 · Fan1 switched return · Q21 internal low-side stage; configure fan function and prove cooling whenever heater is enabled.
C11-003 · Fan2 positive feed · Connect only if fitted or deliberately added, electrically matched and firmware configured.
C11-004 · Fan2 switched return · Q22 internal low-side stage; verify rated load and startup state.

C12-001 · Hotend temperature feedback signal · BQ reference names temperature sensing, but fitted sensor type/lead pairs are not identified. Prime J21.1/.2 supports the board temperature input and return; establish NTC/PT100/thermocouple identity and configure a compatible sensor circuit and firmware. Heater power must remain disabled until feedback, fault detection and independent cutoff are proved. The recycler Inkbird heater remains an independent controller system.
